svg.title: Coding agent generation speed by model and service tier
svg.desc: Three-hour KST buckets, separated by provider, model and service tier. Solid lines are default, dashed lines priority, dotted lines other tiers. Gaps mean no valid measurement. End labels show each series last valid observation.
